# Jeremiah Aworetan - Personal Website

> Frontend engineer building scalable web solutions for seamless user experiences. This website showcases my portfolio of projects, including web applications, landing pages, and development tools.

This website contains information about my work as a frontend engineer, including project showcases, contact information, and professional details. The site is built with Next.js, TypeScript, and modern web technologies.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://www.jeremy0x.dev/): Personal introduction and overview
- [Projects](https://www.jeremy0x.dev/projects): Portfolio showcasing web development projects including GSAP animation concepts, crypto payment solutions, e-commerce platforms, and custom websites
- [Contact](https://www.jeremy0x.dev/contact): Contact information and scheduling calendar

## Projects

- [Curtain Reveal](https://gsap-concepts.jeremy0x.dev/curtain-reveal/): Premium curtain reveal and counting preloader animation concept built with GSAP, CustomEase, and SplitText featuring elegant image fan-out and smooth typography transitions.

- [Card Shuffle Reveal](https://gsap-concepts.jeremy0x.dev/card-shuffle-reveal/): Experimental radial card deck preloader and horizontal toss reveal timeline concept built with GSAP and CustomEase, featuring dynamically scaling full-width typography.

- [Trailer Intro](https://gsap-concepts.jeremy0x.dev/trailer-intro/): Kinetic title sequence reveal concept built with GSAP and Anime.js, featuring staggered text blocks, letter-by-letter typography animation, and floating replay controls.

- [Circle Wipe Intro](https://gsap-concepts.jeremy0x.dev/circle-wipe-intro/): Brand intro sequence featuring floating food items, multi-layered radial circle wipe transition panels, and a custom overlay mobile menu powered by GSAP.

- [Reelpay Mobile App](https://reelpay-web-link.onelink.me/FMTg/925gmol4): Mobile application connecting UGC creators and influencers with brand collaborations, built with Flutter and Dart and available on both Google Play and the Apple App Store.

- [Noblocks](https://noblocks.xyz): Open-source interface for moving between stablecoins and local bank or mobile money accounts across multiple African regions, powered by Paycrest's decentralized liquidity network. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.

- [BriefIntel](https://reelpay.co/briefintel): AI-powered tool for brands to analyze UGC campaign performance and generate optimized content briefs directly from product links, built within the Reelpay platform using Next.js, TypeScript, and Figma.

- [Football for Peace](https://football-for-peace.vercel.app): Immersive animated timeline experience detailing the history of the Football for Peace (Fútbol Por La Paz) initiative, built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and GSAP.

- [Kazlat LIMS](https://lims.kazlatpublicanalysts.com): Lab information management system for Kazlat Public Analysts that tracks sample submissions through analysis, automates invoice generation, and produces signed certificates. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase/PostgreSQL, and Framer Motion.

- [Paycrest](https://paycrest.io): Core business infrastructure for Paycrest spanning their marketing website and Remix-based merchant operations dashboard, tracking transactions, settlements, and liquidity flows.

- [Surgechain](https://app.surgechain.io): DEX trading terminal that consolidates news, pump-fun style memecoins, trending tokens, and perpetuals into a single interface with live on-chain execution, built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase/PostgreSQL.

- [Lync](https://thelync.app): Product landing page for Lync with a modern, conversion-focused Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion design.

- [Noblocks Blog](https://noblocks.xyz/blog): Sanity-powered blog for Noblocks with dynamic content rendering and SEO-focused Next.js integration.

- [AI Titans](https://t.me/AI_Titans_bot): Battle-focused tap-to-earn RPG Telegram Mini App built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and the Telegram SDK for in-chat gameplay and rewards syncing.

- [$Dogatoshi](https://dogatoshi.jeremy0x.dev/): Meme coin community website that explains the $Dogatoshi project with an energetic JavaScript and Tailwind CSS UI.

- [Sesshin](https://sesshin.jeremy0x.dev): Custom brand website with immersive GSAP-powered animations, smooth transitions, and cinematic interactive elements.

- [BahamaFoodie](http://hellobahamafoodie.com): Digital plant-based restaurant platform in The Bahamas with menu browsing, online ordering, and delivery tracking implemented in vanilla JavaScript and GSAP.

- [RoomLink](https://roomlinkng.com/): Agent-free property rental platform in Nigeria that directly connects verified landlords and renters with in-app monthly payments and direct messaging, built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.

- [Shape Up Fitness](https://shapeupfitnessonline.com): Fitness platform showcasing gym services, facilities, schedules, and trainers using React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.

- [Sentinel Finance](https://sentfi.jeremy0x.dev): Proof-of-concept decentralized commerce platform combining e-commerce with blockchain payments using vanilla JavaScript and GSAP.
